items.markdown:
A 2-tier cake `typically features a 6-inch tier stacked on an 8-inch tier, serving 40 to 50 guests` . Prices in Sydney generally range from $140 for simple party styles up to $400+ for custom designs. Stacking requires sturdy internal dowels and a cold, firm base.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TjGi_j4STd4) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TjGi_j4STd4)[[2]](https://frostingandfettuccine.com/two-tier-cake/)[[3]](https://www.risocake.com.au/collections/2-tier-cakes)[[4]](https://yummydelicious.com.au/products/partycakes/2-tier)[[5]](https://www.cakeandspoon.com.au/pricing)

Typical Cake Sizes & Servings

- **Standard:** 6-inch tier on an 8-inch tier (feeds 40–50)
- **Large:** 8-inch tier on a 10-inch tier (feeds 50–60)
- **Coffee vs. Dessert:** Servings can double if cut into smaller "coffee" portions instead of full dessert slices.[](https://frostingandfettuccine.com/two-tier-cake/) [[1]](https://frostingandfettuccine.com/two-tier-cake/)[[2]](https://sherbetbakeshop.au/product/2-tier-3-layer-wedding-cake-copy/)[[3]](https://www.loveitcakes.com.au/products/2-tier-retro-cake)[[4]](https://www.pinterest.com/pin/688558230501113864/)[[5]](https://www.polespatisserie.com.au/products/big-60s-2-tier-cake)

Popular Sydney Bakeries & Prices

- **Ferguson Plarre's Bakehouse:** Offers a range of set designs (e.g., *Classic Dream* or *Aria* ) priced between $140 and $455.
- **Black Velvet Cakes:** Multi-tier buttercream, floral, or drip designs typically range from $240 to $375, often with metro delivery.
- **Sherbet Cafe & Bake Shop:** 2-tier, 3-layer cakes range from $260–$310 with customizable sizes and flavors.[](https://blackvelvetcakes.com.au/collections/multiple-tiered-cakes) [[1]](https://blackvelvetcakes.com.au/collections/multiple-tiered-cakes)[[2]](https://www.fergusonplarre.com.au/two-tier-wedding-cakes)[[3]](https://sherbetbakeshop.au/product/2-tier-3-layer-wedding-cake-copy/)

Essential Stacking Tips

1. **Dowels:** The bottom tier must support the weight of the top tier. Insert 4 or 5 wooden or plastic dowels (or bubble tea straws) cut flush with the top of the bottom cake before stacking.
2. **Cake Boards:** Always place the top tier on its own thin cardboard cake circle so it doesn't sink into the bottom tier.
3. **Chill:** Always fully chill both cakes in the fridge for at least 2 hours before stacking to make handling and moving them much easier.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TjGi_j4STd4) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TjGi_j4STd4)
